limitations: This follow-up changes tests and CI only and maps to no D/A requirement of its own; it extends M04, whose manifest (8df0ea7c) carries A07 and D12, so requirements is empty.
Case hash and environment lock hash are those of the M04 manifest (8df0ea7c): this follow-up adds no case and no environment.

The gate command's stdout_sha256 is the SHA-256 of its one summary line as printed, newline included ('GATE PASS 422c53a: 8681 passed, 31 skipped, 2 deselected, 1 warning in 1524.90s (0:25:24) (log ...)'); gate.sh names HEAD (422c53a) while the tree held 09c6fed's content (E42 uncommitted). The gate before this manifest's commit ran on the tree with the manifest and the harvest.
A40's script path (prewarm under the process executor at max_workers = 4) is not exercised on the hosted x86 runners (2 physical cores); it is checked locally and on ubuntu-24.04-arm (E39).

A49's negative control is vacuous on ubuntu-24.04-arm (aarch64/neoversen2) and on x86_64/SkylakeX hosts: there the pin's claims hold but are not shown to differ from no pin; the split is shown locally and on x86_64/Haswell hosts (E40).

A35's 10-significant-digit float comparison runs on x86_64/Haswell only; elsewhere only the R0 members are compared (spec §18 A1.3 promises R1/R2 for these floats across platforms; no off-class R1/R2 comparator exists, R-253) (E41).
Tested, not reviewed: no design-lane review of E39-E42 yet; not a numerical or process-model sign-off.
